text:
maria: heads-up — product wants a P0 dashboard for reliability that includes timeouts, 5xx, OOMs, and a clear count of degraded-mode fallbacks. question: what signals can runtime/infra realistically emit without exploding cardinality or egress cost?
noah: runtime can emit an event per request with small attrs. propose: deg_mode=true, fallback_kind=(model_swap|cache_miss|retry|scaledown), error_class=(timeout|5xx|oom). small payload ~100 bytes.
sophie: console: +1 on structured fields but we need low-cardinality enums for the dashboard. free-text fallback_reason will break panels. prefer a short enum and optional detail for logs.
maria: @sophie agreed. also need guidance on counting: count per-request (1) vs per-token (n). product expects a single "fallbacks per minute" metric.
alex: infra: per-request counter is easiest and lowest cost. per-token requires hooking into tokenizer path and adds noise/cost. maybe we emit both but sample tokens? not recommended at scale.
jordan: ML: for OOMs we should distinguish model OOM vs infra OOM (out of mem VM) because rollouts differ. runtime can tag "oom_source" = {model_kernel, host_mem}.
noah: implementation sketch (runtime telemetry payload):
```json
{"req_id":"uuid","ts":1680000000,"deg_mode":true,"fallback_kind":"model_swap","error_class":"oom","oom_source":"model_kernel","model":"gpt-7b-q","route_policy":"cost_primary"}
```
sophie: console-side: I want these fields mapped to dashboard dims — route_policy, model, error_class, fallback_kind. we should also provide an aggregated metric: fallback_rate = count(deg_mode && fallback_kind)/count(requests) over 1m.
maria: can we get a minimal schema that runtime agrees to? i'll put this on the reliability OKR board.
noah: registering a schema in telemetry registry now. note: we need to cap high-cardinality "model" values (use model_family field).
ingest-bot: schema registered: telemetry.schemas/reliability.v1 (https://ingest.internal/schemas/reliability.v1) :thumbsup:
sophie: console asks for one additional field: rollout_stage = {prod, canary, fallback} to let us filter canaries in the dashboard.
alex: routing/policy note: if route_policy is used for cost-based fallback, it will change often. recommend keeping route_policy as low-cardinality enum and emitting route_family instead for dashboards.
jordan: on dedupe: OOM sometimes generates both 5xx and oom events. runtime: please emit a canonical "primary_error" field so downstream counts don't double-count.
noah: will emit primary_error where present and also raw events. we'll include request_id for joins.
sophie: UI work — I'll add a dashboard prototype card and a per-model family heatmap panel. can we get a week of test data?
maria: action items: noah implement schema + primary_error; alex verify sampling configs; sophie prototype dashboard; jordan provide example OOM logs; i'll coordinate with product for acceptance criteria.
maria: thx everyone. follow-up sync tomorrow 11am PT?
sophie: works for me.
noah: scheduled.
